scenarios.threat: Household firearm accessible to a minor
scenarios.observable_signal: Caregiver identifies an unlocked firearm or accessible key/code
scenarios.objective: Reduce unauthorized youth access before an incident
scenarios.countermeasure: Voluntary locked and unloaded storage guidance; protect combinations; discounted safe or lock referral
scenarios.verification_method: Anonymous opt-in adoption survey, lock voucher accounting, and caregiver comprehension exercise
scenarios.metric: Number adopting safeguards; non-identifying participation rate
scenarios.rights_gate: Do not collect owner identities, addresses, serials or storage inventories
scenarios.stop_condition: Ownership reporting required or security intervention based solely on ownership

scenarios.threat: Firearm in relatives’, friends’, or shared-care locations
scenarios.observable_signal: Caregiver concern about access during visits or custody transitions
scenarios.objective: Extend protective practice outside primary home
scenarios.countermeasure: Universal caregiver discussion guide; voluntary peer-to-peer secure-storage conversation; translated materials
scenarios.verification_method: Usability test with volunteer caregivers across household types
scenarios.metric: Comprehension and voluntary commitment; language accessibility
scenarios.rights_gate: Do not infer or disclose custody, family firearm holdings, or guardian status
scenarios.stop_condition: Program conditions school access on parental ownership disclosure

scenarios.threat: Unsecured firearm left in a vehicle
scenarios.observable_signal: Voluntary report that firearm was previously left accessible in a vehicle
scenarios.objective: Reduce opportunistic access and theft exposure
scenarios.countermeasure: Avoid unattended vehicle storage; voluntary locked storage education; lawful temporary storage referrals
scenarios.verification_method: Anonymized scenario questionnaire and program distribution audit
scenarios.metric: Change in storage intent or reported practice, without individual tracking
scenarios.rights_gate: No vehicle-owner registry or vehicle searches under education program
scenarios.stop_condition: Law-enforcement vehicle search derived from education enrollment data

scenarios.threat: Credible communicated threat or planning leakage
scenarios.observable_signal: Specific observed statements or behavior with corroborating context
scenarios.objective: Review actionable concern early and initiate proportionate supports
scenarios.countermeasure: Multidisciplinary, behavior-based assessment; documented corroboration; supportive interventions; emergency referral only where justified
scenarios.verification_method: Tabletop case review with synthetic facts and independent review of proportionality
scenarios.metric: Evidence quality, triage timeliness, interventions and overturn rates
scenarios.evidence_label: Supported professional practice, not individual prediction
scenarios.rights_gate: FERPA purpose limits; protected expression alone is not sufficient
scenarios.stop_condition: Unsupported coercion or unsupported record transfer

scenarios.observable_signal: Anonymous allegation lacking independently corroborated conduct
scenarios.objective: Avoid wrongful labeling and retaliatory intervention
scenarios.countermeasure: Separate intake from finding; preserve exculpatory information; corrective review, time limits and appeals
scenarios.verification_method: Synthetic false-report exercise with review by legal and student representatives
scenarios.metric: False escalation rate, correction timeliness and resolution quality
scenarios.rights_gate: Presumption against disciplinary or police action based solely on allegation
scenarios.stop_condition: Student punishment, political profiling or irreversible label without support

scenarios.threat: Suspected weapon or violence near school arrival/access area
scenarios.observable_signal: Direct human report of potential weapon or danger, not algorithmic inference alone
scenarios.objective: Communicate credible urgent risk without exposing additional students
scenarios.countermeasure: Trained human confirmation where safe; dispatch escalation; campus-specific protective action; accessible notification
scenarios.verification_method: No-live-weapon notification tabletop; measure decision and alert chain
scenarios.metric: p50/p95 notification delay and comprehension; missed recipients
scenarios.rights_gate: Avoid publishing campus-sensitive routes or exploitable access points
scenarios.stop_condition: Protective action depends entirely on a network sensor or unvalidated classifier

scenarios.threat: False or missed acoustic/visual firearm alarm
scenarios.observable_signal: Sensor activates without verified incident, or misses simulated signal
scenarios.objective: Avoid harmful false response while retaining urgent notification
scenarios.countermeasure: Independent sensor benchmark; source provenance; human verification; alternate reporting channel
scenarios.verification_method: Controlled authorized synthetic tests, blinded false-positive and false-negative assessments
scenarios.metric: Sensitivity, specificity, alert latency and false alarm workload
scenarios.rights_gate: No automatic suspect identity inference or use-of-force trigger
scenarios.stop_condition: Vendor cannot disclose validation data; false alerts trigger irreversible action

scenarios.threat: Threat reported while groups are in hallways or common areas
scenarios.observable_signal: Verified immediate threat with mixed locations and conflicting movement instructions
scenarios.objective: Support safer protective action appropriate to each location
scenarios.countermeasure: Preplanned options-based training; intelligible multi-channel guidance; trained staff judgement
scenarios.verification_method: Accessible, non-violent exercise with multiple mobility profiles and observers
scenarios.metric: Instruction comprehension, conflicts, accessibility and elapsed communication
scenarios.stop_condition: Single inflexible command unnecessarily exposes or traps occupants

scenarios.threat: Classroom door hardware fails or impedes egress
scenarios.observable_signal: Routine inspection finds fault, incompatible accessory, or emergency release failure
scenarios.objective: Maintain protective closure while preserving lawful egress and emergency access
scenarios.countermeasure: Code-reviewed listed hardware; scheduled inspection; manual opening and release; accessibility testing
scenarios.verification_method: Qualified walk-through under power-off and simulated panic conditions
scenarios.metric: Every tested door independently satisfies egress/accessibility criteria
scenarios.rights_gate: No unsanctioned door lock-in or incapacitating enclosure
scenarios.stop_condition: Any tested exit obstruction or inability to release from inside

scenarios.threat: Person with disability cannot perceive or follow protective instruction
scenarios.observable_signal: Audible-only alert or obstructed accessible exit
scenarios.objective: Ensure inclusive, independently usable emergency action
scenarios.countermeasure: Multimodal accessible alerts, individualized support planning, accessible refuge/egress review
scenarios.verification_method: Inclusive drill with disabled participants and voluntary accommodations
scenarios.metric: Notification reach, support timeliness and documented accessibility defects
scenarios.evidence_label: Accessibility duty; specific benefit must be tested
scenarios.rights_gate: Do not expose medical or disability details in broad alerts
scenarios.stop_condition: Protective protocol excludes or isolates disabled occupants

scenarios.threat: Power or communications outage during incident
scenarios.observable_signal: Loss of power, WAN, cellular, or security control unit
scenarios.objective: Maintain minimum alerts, unlocked legal egress, and command continuity
scenarios.countermeasure: Tested backup power; manual public address / radio alternatives; fail-safe access and written procedures
scenarios.verification_method: Authorized loss-of-power functional test with observer and fire authority
scenarios.metric: Continuity of essential functions; restoration time and failed transitions
scenarios.rights_gate: Backup cannot override life-safety release or logging rules
scenarios.stop_condition: Any power loss locks an occupied exit or disables all emergency notification

scenarios.threat: Spoofed alert, ransomware, or compromised access-control system
scenarios.observable_signal: Unexpected vendor login, unsigned command, inconsistent emergency message
scenarios.objective: Prevent cyber compromise from creating unsafe physical behavior
scenarios.countermeasure: MFA; least privilege; segmentation; signed updates; manual override; offline incident playbook
scenarios.verification_method: Authorized tabletop and isolated cyber-physical failure injection (no live student impact)
scenarios.metric: Time to detect/contain; uncompromised exit function; recovery success
scenarios.evidence_label: NIST/CISA control guidance; site testing required
scenarios.rights_gate: Do not connect surveillance telemetry to general police databases
scenarios.stop_condition: Remote operator can close all egress or issue unverified lethal-threat instructions

scenarios.observable_signal: Observed injury requiring immediate emergency medical response
scenarios.objective: Make trained assistance and supplies accessible before professional arrival
scenarios.countermeasure: Bleeding-control kits, trained personnel, accessible cache locations, EMS handoff coordination
scenarios.verification_method: Skills-based medical training and equipment inspection; coordinate with qualified clinicians
scenarios.metric: Training coverage, kit readiness, performance in safe simulation
scenarios.rights_gate: Do not collect student-specific medical details beyond lawful operational need
scenarios.stop_condition: Kits inaccessible or training not sustained

scenarios.threat: Delayed police arrival during an active threat
scenarios.observable_signal: Dispatch acknowledges incident but units are not yet on scene
scenarios.objective: Reduce dependence on a single external response timeline
scenarios.countermeasure: Protective actions, verified alarms, trained communications lead, EMS staging; only legally authorized professional security with oversight
scenarios.owner: District emergency lead / law enforcement agency
scenarios.verification_method: Multi-agency tabletop; timed non-weapon exercise; authority and ID checks
scenarios.metric: Reliable dispatch interface, communications robustness, accountable authority
scenarios.evidence_label: Operational planning; armed response outcome varies
scenarios.rights_gate: No armed deployment outside legal authority, training and explicit policy
scenarios.stop_condition: Unqualified staff armed or force authority delegated to software

scenarios.threat: Canine false indication, injury, or unreliable deployment
scenarios.observable_signal: Canine proposed for explosives/firearms screening or a positive indication occurs
scenarios.objective: Avoid unvalidated claims and secondary physical harms
scenarios.countermeasure: Qualified canine/handler credentialing; validated application-specific reliability; welfare and student safety review
scenarios.verification_method: Double-blind controlled screening trials; documented incident review
scenarios.metric: False indication rate, coverage, handler performance, injury near-misses
scenarios.evidence_label: Limited context-specific evidence; not proven mass-shooting prevention
scenarios.rights_gate: No random intrusive student search based solely on dog alert without lawful grounds
scenarios.stop_condition: Insufficient canine validation or foreseeable student bite/exposure risk

scenarios.threat: Misidentified person or unauthorized on-site use of force
scenarios.observable_signal: Confusing observations; responder has incomplete incident picture
scenarios.objective: Protect innocent people, enforce constitutional limits and prevent friendly-force errors
scenarios.countermeasure: Qualified law-enforcement coordination; identification and restraint standards; independent force review; medical response
scenarios.verification_method: Legal policy review, credentials audit and scenario-based decision exercise without weapons
scenarios.metric: Misidentification risks, policy compliance, reporting completeness
scenarios.evidence_label: Law/policy gate, not demonstrated intervention efficacy
scenarios.rights_gate: Never provide target selection, automated force recommendation or unreviewed force authority
scenarios.stop_condition: Unlawful force policy; missing chain of command or independent review

scenarios.threat: AI-generated accusation, synthetic media, or automated threat score
scenarios.observable_signal: Suspicious synthetic audio/video or automated recommendation presents urgent allegation
scenarios.objective: Require authentic, corroborated evidence before adverse action
scenarios.countermeasure: Source verification, human case review, multiple independent observations and challenge process
scenarios.verification_method: Adversarial synthetic exercise, subgroup error analysis and documentation review
scenarios.metric: False escalation, reversals, provenance verification success
scenarios.rights_gate: No student risk scoring, mass surveillance, or AI-only enforcement
scenarios.stop_condition: Model recommendation is treated as proof or enables automatic police action

scenarios.threat: After-event reunification confusion or sensitive-data leakage
scenarios.observable_signal: Families receive contradictory or over-detailed status messages
scenarios.objective: Accountable reunification, privacy and trauma-informed communication
scenarios.countermeasure: Single authorized family information lead, secure verification, accessible multilingual updates
scenarios.verification_method: Family-facing tabletop, multilingual review, redacted communication audit
scenarios.metric: Family comprehension, rumor correction time, unauthorized releases
scenarios.rights_gate: No public posting of pupil identities or sensitive medical data
scenarios.stop_condition: Live roster exposed or misinformation uncontrolled
